name: bento-grid
title: Bento grid
description: A responsive asymmetric grid of cards with column and row spans.
a11y: Plain divs in source order, so reading and tab order match the visual order on phones and follow the DOM elsewhere.
Spans collapse to a single column on narrow screens; nothing depends on colour or motion.

props.name: colSpan
props.description: Columns to span once the grid has room for them. Default 1.
